name: Nahrai
title: Joab's armor-bearer from Beeroth
summary: Nahrai was a Beerothite who served as the armor-bearer for Joab, son of Zeruiah, who was the commander of King David's army. He is mentioned among David's mighty warriors, an elite group known as "the thirty." His role as armor-bearer to the most powerful general in David's army testifies to his bravery and reliability.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned Among David's Heroes
keyEvents.description: Nahrai the Beerothite is listed among David's mighty men, an elite group of warriors who distinguished themselves in service to the king.

keyEvents.title: Listed in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Nahrai is also mentioned in 1 Chronicles as Joab's armor-bearer, confirming his important role in David's military organization.

keyEvents.title: Service as Joab's Armor-Bearer
keyEvents.description: Nahrai held the trusted position of armor-bearer for Joab, son of Zeruiah, who was the commander-in-chief of all Israel's army under David.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's Elite Warrior Group
keyEvents.description: As one of "the thirty," Nahrai belonged to the chosen group of warriors who formed the core of David's military force and distinguished themselves through brave deeds.
